name: None Other Gods
desc: Benson's novel of 1910 of a young English earl, Frank Guiseley, who becomes a Catholic and is led by it to a life of sacrifice, set against the idols of modern society.
desc_pt: O romance de Benson (1910) sobre um jovem conde inglês, Frank Guiseley, que se torna católico e é levado por isso a uma vida de sacrifício, diante dos ídolos da sociedade moderna.
edition: None Other Gods (London: Hutchinson, 1910), Project Gutenberg #17627, proofread.
srcnote: Parts and chapters as printed; the numbered sections inside chapters are kept as ## headings.
